name: Skip link
summary: Use a skip link as the first focusable control so keyboard users can bypass repeated navigation and move to main content.
whenToUse: Include on every page with repeated header or navigation content.
Target the unique main-content landmark ID.
whenNotToUse: Do not omit it because the page appears short at one viewport size.
Do not point it at an element that is missing, hidden or earlier in the focus order.

anatomy.name: Skip anchor
anatomy.description: A govuk-skip-link with a fragment href appears at the start of body content.

anatomy.name: Target landmark
anatomy.description: The fragment resolves to the main element's unique ID.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: The first focusable element in the GOV.UK page template.

behaviour: Initialise GOV.UK Frontend so the module can manage focus on targets that are not naturally focusable.
The anchor and fragment still provide useful navigation without JavaScript.
Do not intercept activation or replace fragment navigation with scrolling alone.
accessibility: Keep the link first in the useful keyboard order and visibly expose it on focus.
Use a stable target such as main#main-content and verify focus moves there in supported browsers.
Localise the link text for the page language.
content: Use “Skip to main content” unless the target has a clearer established localised label.
Do not add several skip links unless the page structure and user testing demonstrate a need.
